title: BookRush / Feed & Recommendations
description: FD-06, FD-07 and FD-11. Operational recommendation signals with explicit instrumentation gaps.

options.content:
### NOT_INSTRUMENTED

No persisted PFV1 shadow-overlap metric is currently exported. This panel is deliberately explicit so overlap is not confused with zero or causal uplift.

**Required source:** recommendation ledger + assignment snapshot (dash-08/09).

Feed request/ranking counters are operational signals only. Viewability, attribution, confidence and conversion require the versioned reporting facts/API and must not be reconstructed from Prometheus.
